results.policy: Similar-case memory: take when similar earlier cases paid
Validated lessons: take when lessons net favour the signal
Validated lessons: skip only when lessons net oppose
Lessons + similar cases must both agree

exam.note: Plan results include published bid/ask and $0.10 slippage; stop checked before targets within a minute; 4 h horizon; ⅓ off at each target, stop to entry after TP1.

replay.method: Closed candles only. First executable quote at the next minute open. Stop first within ambiguous bars. TP2 basket exit. Sequential 20-minute observations with boundary purges. Drawdown in cumulative initial-risk units.
replay.costBasis: MID converted to synthetic BID; USD/oz spread, per-side slippage, and round-trip commission. Minute resolution.
